Source Actor plus original embedded IDs allow PF2-origin original embedded items, while later foreign items and nested foreign rows stay untouched.
Personal Actors permit module-origin item/strike rows only.

All contenteditable regions including inherited or explicitly false descendants are excluded conservatively.

knownLimitations: No live installed Foundry/PF2e session was available; tested real browser DOM fixtures and official-source structures, not a running game.
Exact whole-text-node lookup only. Different casing, punctuation, mixed fragments, or alternate sheet markup can remain English. No fuzzy general translation.

Raw source rule Note strings and unexpected/enriched alternate Note DOM shapes remain unchanged. Special damage sentence requires exact source effect UUID, original Note rule, damage-received selector, item ID, and one known direct damage-roll anchor.

Imported Actors whose embedded IDs are regenerated cannot use the original-ID allowlist; independently module-origin items still qualify. User-modified original items keep their identity and can receive exact dictionary matches.
Input/select values remain English; text inputs show a sibling Chinese reading. Numeric inputs, textarea, editors, placeholders/tooltips/ARIA labels and unsupported custom widgets are not translated.
Only the 456 reviewed exact phrases are provided; unrelated PF2 source items outside original source Actors are intentionally excluded.
